input: Schedule a hearing test at the audiologist

gold.taskTitle: Schedule a Hearing Test at the Audiologist
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to book an appointment for a hearing test with an audiologist.

questions.title: Do you already have a specific audiologist in mind?
questions.description: Determine whether the user has an existing provider or needs to find one.

questions.title: Has a doctor referred you, or is this self-initiated?
questions.description: Understand whether a referral or prescription is involved, which may affect booking.

questions.title: What is prompting you to get this test now?
questions.description: Clarify the reason — routine check, hearing loss concern, tinnitus, etc.

questions.title: How soon do you need the appointment booked?
questions.description: Establish urgency and the target timeframe for scheduling.

questions.title: Are there specific days or times that work for you?
questions.description: Identify scheduling constraints or preferences for the appointment.

questions.title: Does it need to be covered by your insurance?
questions.description: Determine whether insurance coverage or an in-network provider is a requirement.

questions.title: How far are you willing to travel for this appointment?
questions.description: Understand location constraints to help narrow down suitable providers.
